description:
## Problem (reproduced)
`ClickHouseTuningMixin.apply_table_tunings` (`benchbox/platforms/clickhouse/tuning.py:319-345`) runs `OPTIMIZE TABLE {table_tuning.table_name} FINAL` during `apply_unified_tuning`. The name is the template's uppercase name, so it fails on case-sensitive ClickHouse ("Table default.LINEITEM does not exist"). It also runs before data is loaded, so it would be a no-op anyway. The failed statement vetoes `applied_verified`. This affects ClickHouse local, server and cloud.

## Change
- Delete the OPTIMIZE calls from apply.
- Run the opt-in OPTIMIZE through `apply_post_load_tunings` (`tuning-post-load-seam-20261001`), with names from `tuning-physical-identifier-resolution-20261001`, recorded as `post_load` (maintenance, non-blocking).

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- OPTIMIZE never runs pre-load.
- A failure is recorded as failed and never breaks the run.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
